title: Poincaré inequality on the cube Q_δ for C¹ functions, double-integral form
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, δ ≥ 0 and Q_δ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i} ⊆ Euclid n (Lebesgue measure). For every C¹ function v : ℝⁿ → ℝ, ∫_{x ∈ Q_δ} ∫_{y ∈ Q_δ} |v(x) − v(y)| dy dx ≤ 2ⁿ√n ∫_{Q_δ} ‖Dv‖, where 2ⁿ√n = 2^{m+1}√(m + 1) and ‖Dv(x)‖ is the operator norm of fderiv ℝ v x.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (δ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → 0 ≤ δ → ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |v x - v y| ≤ 2 ^ (m + 1) * Real.sqrt (m + 1) * ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖
